characters.name: Liang Shuyi
characters.style: Defensive stabilizer who converts small hands into consistent wins
characters.desire: To prove that patience and calculation outweigh raw instinct
characters.flaw: Freezes under extreme pressure and defaults to overly safe play

characters.name: Chen Haoran
characters.style: Aggressive riichi specialist who forces opponent mistakes
characters.desire: To dominate every table he sits at and earn national recognition
characters.flaw: Overcommits to riichi even when the expected value is negative

characters.name: Zhou Mingxia
characters.style: Veteran all-rounder who reads the flow of the entire game
characters.desire: To mentor the next generation before retiring from competitive play
characters.flaw: Physical stamina is declining and she struggles in marathon tournaments

characters.name: Xu Bowen
characters.style: High-risk high-reward player chasing massive hands
characters.desire: To build the most memorable comeback in tournament history
characters.flaw: Reckless calls and discards to chase yakuman regardless of score

characters.name: Sun Yifei
characters.style: Calculated predator who exploits positional disadvantages in others
characters.desire: To prove that cold logic beats warm-blooded passion at the table
characters.flaw: Arrogant and dismissive of opponents he considers beneath him

characters.name: Zheng Lianhua
characters.style: Elegant player who constructs beautiful complex hands with grace
characters.desire: To elevate mahjong to an art form that transcends mere competition
characters.flaw: Prioritizes aesthetic hands over optimal winning probability

characters.name: Huang Qitian
characters.style: Methodical analyst who dissects every discard for hidden information
characters.desire: To develop a perfect predictive model of opponent hands
characters.flaw: Tanks too long on decisions and loses time pressure composure

characters.name: Lin Chaoyang
characters.style: Unconventional disruptor who shifts game tempo unpredictably
characters.desire: To make every opponent doubt everything they thought they knew
characters.flaw: Inconsistent results because his chaos sometimes collapses his own hands
